notes.title: Add Preparation Time & Menu Optimization
notes.content:
Dear Players,
In order to bring you better gaming experience, we added 3 seconds preparation time after a pause return so you will be prepared after returning to the game.
Also, we optimized the menu in the upper left corner.

Thank you for your understanding and support. Shall you have any problem, don’t hesitate to tell us. We will deal with it asap.

Updates:
1. Add “Preparation Time” after a pause return.
2. Optimize the menu.

tags.feature: 1. Add “Preparation Time” after a pause return.

notes.title: Add key customization function and other updates
notes.content:
Dear players:
We have added the key customization, please use this function to define your own keys.
However, we  have found that some keyboards cannot support specific 4 keys combination, so we provide a test function.
After setting, we recommend testing your keys combination whether it works correctly.If it doesn't, please change your setting.

Thank your for your understanding and support again.If you have any problems with NEKO PAPALA, plese report to us immediately.We will deal with it as soon as possible.
Thanks  all of you.

Update:

1.Key customization
2.Menu UI update(In Song Select UI)
3.Rhythm game UI update

notes.title: Download / Update Issues Has Been Settled
notes.content:
Dear Player,

First of all, thank you for supporting NEKO PAPALA.
We have received some player's feedbacks of download/update issues.

After collecting your precious feedbacks, we have already fix it.
Should you had any download/update issue, please download/update again to deal with this problem.

We are willing to receive any suggestion and feedback from you as well as keep improving ourselves to give you the best gaming experiances.
